name: powershell-7.6.7
purpose: Upstream PowerShell 7 as WitOS's default command shell (RFC 0020 section 59, plan step C1.3): the release's framework-dependent archive that is IL alone (no ReadyToRun code, so one archive serves every ISA), pinned by the SHA-256 of its bytes and run unchanged as dotnet pwsh.dll from the data volume on the .NET install; and the source of its native library libpsl-native, PowerShell-Native at the tag nearest the package version the archive names (700.0.2), built unchanged by the pinned clang against the sysroot for each ISA, since the archive's prebuilt musl library needs libstdc++ and the witos RIDs would not select it. The newest release when the step was made; a later one moves the pin.
